run_population_trial: run a population trial with a dict of power to agent mappings and a CompareAgentsTask config
run_population_trial_from_saved_game: run a population trial starting from a saved game JSON file rolled back to a specific phase
run_population_trial_with_stalemate_draw: run a population trial that declares a draw if no power reaches 18 centers within stalemate years
run_population_trial_with_annotations: run a population trial that captures kickoff annotations and saves partial results during execution
run_population_trial_determine_winner: run a population trial and determine the winning power by center count or NONE if no power reaches 18
